reasoning_content: pnpm and nx installed in /opt/node/bin. Add to PATH. Let me create profile.d symlinks.

action.command: for b in node npm npx pnpm pnpx nx nx-cloud corepack; do ln -sf /opt/node/bin/$b /usr/local/bin/$b 2>/dev/null; done; hash -r; pnpm -v; nx --version 2>&1 | head -2
